Clarify external data processing and payment validation; attach exact GitHub source provenance.

Initial release of Utilia Solana Preflight skill.

- Enables live Solana mainnet priority fee estimation, transaction diagnosis, token-risk inspection, and unsigned transaction simulation.
- Supports public PDF-to-Markdown conversion via Utilia's x402 wallet-funded client.
- Requires configuration of a dedicated agent wallet with USDC and SOL balance.
- Provides exact command examples and strict payment handling ($0.01/call max) with no API key required.
- Integrates with MCP for persistent tool access to Solana and PDF utilities.
